title: Promote Immortal (Implementor)
body:
Syntax: promoteimm <account> <builder|area leader|administrator>

Description: Raises an existing immortal account to a higher staff rank and saves the change immediately. Use makeimm <account> first for a player account. Only Biran's Implementor account can use this command. It cannot demote staff or grant Implementor.

Examples: promoteimm Kakashi builder; promoteimm Kakashi area leader; promoteimm Kakashi administrator

Date: 2026-09-29
